As technology increases, researchers are beginning to imple- ment robotics in the ﬁeld, creating sustainability for farmers amid declining labor supply and increasing food demand. In addition to using robotics technology, a farmer can also use “precision agriculture” [3]: a way to create efﬁcient cultivation by maximizing production while minimizing costs, which is very compatible with robotics [4].
